crossRefs.note: All the people shall hear and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.
Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
translations.bsb: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and will never again do such a wicked thing among you.
